meta: Praise and give feedback to keep your staff: employees tend to quit when the owner only speaks up about mistakes.

muc.title: Speaking up only about mistakes
muc.text: Staff tend to quit when the owner only speaks up about mistakes. Timely praise and well-delivered feedback help keep people.

muc.title: Be specific
muc.text: Praise specifically, like "you arranged the shelf so neatly that customers find things faster", instead of just "great job".

muc.title: In private, about the work
muc.text: Give feedback in private, about the work rather than the person, then pick one thing to fix together.

muc.title: Rehearse what to say
muc.text: Tell a chatbot the situation, no real names needed, and ask for three gentle ways to say it.

muc.title: One compliment today
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for a two-sentence compliment on something good an employee did, then say it in person.
